i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n            const size_t idx = (size_t)(ty + 16 * i) * ldc + tx + 16 * j;\n            if (SUB) Cb[idx] -= acc[i][j];\n            else     Cb[idx] = acc[i][j];\n        }\n}\n\n// Cholesky factorization of a single TILE x TILE diagonal block held in shared memory.\n// On success the lower triangle (incl. diagonal) holds L and the strict upper\n// triangle is zeroed. On failure (non positive pivot) the global index of the first\n// failing diagonal element is recorded in *failFlag (initialised to -1 by the host).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(256)\npotrf_tile_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t ld, int globalRow0, int* __restrict__ failFlag) {\n    __shared__ double s[TILE][TILE + 1];\n    __shared__ int failed;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < TILE * TILE; idx += 256) {\n        const int r = idx / TILE, c = idx % TILE;\n        s[r][c] = A[(size_t)r * ld + c];\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) failed = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < TILE; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double val = s[j][j];\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                failed = 1;\n                atomicCAS(failFlag, -1, globalRow0 + j);\n            } else {\n                s[j][j] = sqrt(val);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (failed) return;\n        const int rem = TILE - 1 - j;  // rows below the pivot\n        const double d = s[j][j];\n        if (tid < rem) s[j + 1 + tid][j] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // Rank-1 update of the trailing (lower) part of the block.\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < rem * rem; idx += 256) {\n            const int i = j + 1 + idx / rem;\n            const int m = j + 1 + idx % rem;\n            if (m <= i) s[i][m] -= s[i][j] * s[m][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < TILE * TILE; idx += 256) {\n        const int r = idx / TILE, c = idx % TILE;\n        A[(size_t)r * ld + c] = (c <= r) ? s[r][c] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Triangular solve X := X * L^{-T} for a block of TILE rows of X (each TILE wide).\n// L is the TILE x TILE lower triangular diagonal block. One thread per row.\nconstexpr size_t TRSM_SHMEM = sizeof(double) * (TILE * TILE + TILE * (TILE + 1));\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TILE)\ntrsm_tile_kernel(const double* __restrict__ L, size_t ldl, double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx) {\n    extern __shared__ double shm[];\n    double (*Ls)[TILE] = reinterpret_cast<double (*)[TILE]>(shm);\n    double (*Xs)[TILE + 1] = reinterpret_cast<double (*)[TILE + 1]>(shm + TILE * TILE);\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    double* Xb = X + (size_t)blockIdx.x * TILE * ldx;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < TILE; ++r) {\n        Ls[r][tid] = L[(size_t)r * ldl + tid];\n        Xs[r][tid] = Xb[(size_t)r * ldx + tid];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Row `tid`: x[p] = (x[p] - sum_{q<p} x[q] * L[p][q]) / L[p][p]\n    for (int p = 0; p < TILE; ++p) {\n        double v = Xs[tid][p];\n        for (int q = 0; q < p; ++q) v -= Xs[tid][q] * Ls[p][q];\n        Xs[tid][p] = v / Ls[p][p];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < TILE; ++r) Xb[(size_t)r * ldx + tid] = Xs[r][tid];\n}\n\n// dst[r][0..W) = src[globalCol(cStart + r) - rowOff][0..W)   for r < R\n__global__ void gather_rows_kernel(const double* __restrict__ src, size_t lds,\n                                   double* __restrict__ dst, size_t ldd,\n                                   int R, int W, int cStart, int nb, int P, int rank, int rowOff) {\n    const int r = blockIdx.y;\n    const int p = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= R || p >= W) return;\n    const int srcRow = globalCol(cStart + r, nb, P, rank) - rowOff;\n    dst[(size_t)r * ldd + p] = src[(size_t)srcRow * lds + p];\n}\n\n// Add the diagonal shift: A[i][i] += n for i < n, padded diagonal entries become 1.\n__global__ void add_diagonal_kernel(double* __restrict__ Aloc, int nloc, int nb, int P, int rank,\n                                    int n) {\n    const int c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (c >= nloc) return;\n    const int i = globalCol(c, nb, P, rank);\n    Aloc[(size_t)i * nloc + c] += (i < n) ? (double)n : 1.0;\n}\n\n// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side wrappers\n// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntemplate <bool SUB, bool SKIP>\nvoid gemmNT(const double* A, size_t lda, const double* B, size_t ldb, double* C, size_t ldc,\n            int M, int N, int K, int rowOffset, int cLocal0, const Layout& L) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0 || K <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid(N / TILE, M / TILE);\n    gemm_nt_kernel<SUB, SKIP><<<grid, GEMM_THREADS>>>(A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc, K, rowOffset,\n                                                      cLocal0, L.nb, L.P, L.rank);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid gatherRows(const double* src, size_t lds, double* dst, size_t ldd, int R, int W,\n                int cStart, int rowOff, const Layout& L) {\n    if (R <= 0 || W <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid((W + 255) / 256, R);\n    gather_rows_kernel<<<grid, 256>>>(src, lds, dst, ldd, R, W, cStart, L.nb, L.P, L.rank, rowOff);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nstruct DeviceState {\n    double* Aloc = nullptr;   // np x nloc, row-major (ld = nloc)\n    double* panel = nullptr;  // received panel rows, (np - nb) x nb, row-major (ld = nb)\n    double* Bg = nullptr;     // gathered panel rows for the local columns, nloc x nb\n    int* failFlag = nullptr;\n};\n\n// Factor global block column k (owned by this rank): POTRF of the diagonal block and\n// TRSM of the rows below it, using an inner blocking of TILE. Returns the global index\n// of the first non-positive pivot or -1 on success.\nint factorPanel(const Layout& L, DeviceState& d, int k) {\n    const size_t ldl = (size_t)L.nloc;\n    const int r0 = k * L.nb;\n    const int c0 = L.localColOf(k);\n    const double* panelBase = d.Aloc + (size_t)r0 * ldl + c0;\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < L.nb / TILE; ++c) {\n        const int rr = r0 + c * TILE;\n        const int cc = c0 + c * TILE;\n        const int M = L.np - rr;\n        const int K = c * TILE;\n        double* slab = d.Aloc + (size_t)rr * ldl + cc;\n        // Left-looking update of the current TILE-wide column slab with the already\n        // factored columns of this panel.\n        if (K > 0) {\n            const double* X = d.Aloc + (size_t)rr * ldl + c0;\n            gemmNT<true, false>(X, ldl, X, ldl, slab, ldl, M, TILE, K, 0, 0, L);\n        }\n        potrf_tile_kernel<<<1, 256>>>(slab, ldl, rr, d.failFlag);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        if (M - TILE > 0) {\n            trsm_tile_kernel<<<(M - TILE) / TILE, TILE, TRSM_SHMEM>>>(\n                slab, ldl, slab + (size_t)TILE * ldl, ldl);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n    }\n    (void)panelBase;\n    int flag = -1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&flag, d.failFlag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    return flag;\n}\n\n// Distributed right-looking blocked Cholesky with look-ahead. On return the lower\n// triangle of the distributed matrix holds L. Returns false if the matrix is not\n// positive definite (the owning rank prints the diagnostic, like the reference code).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(const Layout& L, DeviceState& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    if (L.NB == 0) return true;\n\n    const size_t ldl = (size_t)L.nloc;\n    const size_t panelMax = (size_t)std::max(L.np - L.nb, 0) * L.nb + 1;\n    double* hbuf[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hbuf[0], panelMax * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hbuf[1], panelMax * sizeof(double)));\n    MPI_Request req[2] = {MPI_REQUEST_NULL, MPI_REQUEST_NULL};\n\n    // Copy the part of panel k below the diagonal block to the host (owner) and start\n    // its broadcast. The last element of the message carries the failure status.\n    auto postPanel = [&](int k, int status) {\n        const int Mrem = L.np - (k + 1) * L.nb;\n        const size_t count = (size_t)Mrem * L.nb;\n        double* hb = hbuf[k & 1];\n        if (L.ownerOf(k) == L.rank) {\n            if (Mrem > 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(hb, (size_t)L.nb * sizeof(double),\n                                        d.Aloc + (size_t)(k + 1) * L.nb * ldl + L.localColOf(k),\n                                        ldl * sizeof(double), (size_t)L.nb * sizeof(double),\n                                        (size_t)Mrem, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n            hb[count] = (double)status;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(hb, (int)(count + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, L.ownerOf(k), comm, &req[k & 1]);\n    };\n\n    auto reportFailure = [&](int status) {\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\\n\", status);\n        fflush(stdout);\n    };\n\n    int status = -1;\n    if (L.ownerOf(0) == L.rank) {\n        status = factorPanel(L, d, 0);\n        if (status >= 0) reportFailure(status);\n    }\n    postPanel(0, status);\n\n    bool ok = true;\n    for (int k = 0; k < L.NB; ++k) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req[k & 1], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        const int Mrem = L.np - (k + 1) * L.nb;\n        const double* hb = hbuf[k & 1];\n        if (hb[(size_t)Mrem * L.nb] >= 0.0) { ok = false; break; }\n        if (k == L.NB - 1) break;\n\n        // Panel k rows below the diagonal block, on the device.\n        const double* Pd;\n        size_t ldp;\n        if (L.ownerOf(k) == L.rank) {\n            Pd = d.Aloc + (size_t)(k + 1) * L.nb * ldl + L.localColOf(k);\n            ldp = ldl;\n        } else {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d.panel, hb, (size_t)Mrem * L.nb * sizeof(double),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            Pd = d.panel;\n            ldp = (size_t)L.nb;\n        }\n\n        const int cStart = L.firstLocalColAfter(k);\n        const int Ncols = L.nloc - cStart;\n        const int rowOff = (k + 1) * L.nb;\n        gatherRows(Pd, ldp, d.Bg, (size_t)L.nb, Ncols, L.nb, cStart, rowOff, L);\n\n        double* Ctrail = d.Aloc + (size_t)rowOff * ldl + cStart;\n        if (L.ownerOf(k + 1) == L.rank) {\n            // Look-ahead: update and factor the next panel first, start its broadcast,\n            // then update the remaining local columns.\n            gemmNT<true, true>(Pd, ldp, d.Bg, (size_t)L.nb, Ctrail, ldl, Mrem, L.nb, L.nb,\n                               rowOff, cStart, L);\n            int st = factorPanel(L, d, k + 1);\n            if (st >= 0) reportFailure(st);\n            postPanel(k + 1, st);\n            gemmNT<true, true>(Pd, ldp, d.Bg + (size_t)L.nb * L.nb, (size_t)L.nb,\n                               Ctrail + L.nb, ldl, Mrem, Ncols - L.nb, L.nb,\n                               rowOff, cStart + L.nb, L);\n        } else {\n            gemmNT<true, true>(Pd, ldp, d.Bg, (size_t)L.nb, Ctrail, ldl, Mrem, Ncols, L.nb,\n                               rowOff, cStart, L);\n            postPanel(k + 1, -1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {\n        if (req[i] != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) MPI_Wait(&req[i], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hbuf[0]));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hbuf[1]));\n    return ok;\n}\n\n// Generate the symmetric positive definite test matrix A = B * B^T + n * I directly in\n// the distributed layout. B is the same deterministic random matrix as in the\n// reference code; the product is evaluated on the GPU with the same per-element\n// accumulation order.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(const Layout& L, DeviceState& d) {\n    const size_t np = (size_t)L.np;\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    std::vector<double> Bpad(np * np, 0.0);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double* row = Bpad.data() + i * np;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            row[j] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n        }\n    }\n\n    double* dB = nullptr;\n    double* dBg = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, std::max<size_t>(np * np, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dBg, std::max<size_t>(np * L.nloc, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, Bpad.data(), np * np * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    gatherRows(dB, np, dBg, np, L.nloc, L.np, 0, 0, L);\n    gemmNT<false, false>(dB, np, dBg, np, d.Aloc, (size_t)L.nloc, L.np, L.nloc, L.np, 0, 0, L);\n    if (L.nloc > 0) {\n        add_diagonal_kernel<<<(L.nloc + 255) / 256, 256>>>(d.Aloc, L.nloc, L.nb, L.P, L.rank,\n                                                           (int)L.n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dBg));\n}\n\n// Gather the distributed factor into a full (padded) row-major matrix on every rank,\n// with the strict upper triangle zeroed.\nvoid gatherFactor(const Layout& L, const DeviceState& d, MPI_Comm comm, std::vector<double>& Lfull) {\n    const size_t np = (size_t)L.np;\n    std::vector<double> local(np * (size_t)L.nloc);\n    if (!local.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local.data(), d.Aloc, local.size() * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    MPI_Datatype chunk;  // nb doubles, keeps the counts small\n    MPI_Type_contiguous(L.nb, MPI_DOUBLE, &chunk);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&chunk);\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(L.P), displs(L.P);\n    size_t total = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        const int nl = Layout::localColsOf(r, L.NB, L.P, L.nb);\n        counts[r] = (int)(np * (size_t)nl / L.nb);\n        displs[r] = (int)total;\n        total += (size_t)counts[r];\n    }\n    std::vector<double> recv(total * (size_t)L.nb);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(local.data(), counts[L.rank], chunk, recv.data(), counts.data(),\n                   displs.data(), chunk, comm);\n    MPI_Type_free(&chunk);\n\n    Lfull.assign(np * np, 0.0);\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        const int nl = Layout::localColsOf(r, L.NB, L.P, L.nb);\n        if (nl == 0) continue;\n        const double* src = recv.data() + (size_t)displs[r] * L.nb;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < L.np; ++i) {\n            const double* srow = src + (size_t)i * nl;\n            double* drow = Lfull.data() + (size_t)i * np;\n            for (int bl = 0; bl * L.P + r < L.NB; ++bl) {\n                const int gc0 = (bl * L.P + r) * L.nb;\n                const int w = std::min(L.nb, i + 1 - gc0);  // columns <= i only\n                for (int p = 0; p < w; ++p) drow[gc0 + p] = srow[bl * L.nb + p];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate by computing L * L^T (distributed over ranks and GPUs) and comparing with the\n// original matrix; semantics as in the reference implementation.\nbool validateCholesky(const Layout& L, const std::vector<double>& Lfull,\n                      const std::vector<double>& Aorig, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const size_t np = (size_t)L.np;\n    double* dL = nullptr;\n    double* dLg = nullptr;\n    double* dR = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, std::max<size_t>(np * np, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLg, std::max<size_t>(np * L.nloc, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dR, std::max<size_t>(np * L.nloc, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL, Lfull.data(), np * np * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    gatherRows(dL, np, dLg, np, L.nloc, L.np, 0, 0, L);\n    gemmNT<false, false>(dL, np, dLg, np, dR, (size_t)L.nloc, L.np, L.nloc, L.np, 0, 0, L);\n\n    std::vector<double> recon(np * (size_t)L.nloc);\n    if (!recon.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(recon.data(), dR, recon.size() * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dL));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dLg));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dR));\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    const int n = (int)L.n;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < L.nloc; ++c) {\n            if (globalCol(c, L.nb, L.P, L.rank) >= n) continue;\n            const size_t idx = (size_t)i * L.nloc + c;\n            const double error = fabs(recon[idx] - Aorig[idx]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(Aorig[idx]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n    double g[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, g, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, comm);\n    maxError = g[0];\n    relError = g[1];\n\n    if (L.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (L.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint finish(int code) {\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return code;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n    int rank = 0, P = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(comm, &P);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return finish(0);\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return finish(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // One GPU per rank: ranks sharing a node pick distinct devices.\n    {\n        MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(comm, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n        int localRank = 0;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n        int devCount = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount));\n        if (devCount < 1) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(comm, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % devCount));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(trsm_tile_kernel,\n                                        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                        (int)TRSM_SHMEM));\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads per rank: %d\\n\", P, omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Block size: wide panels for large matrices, more parallel steps for small ones.\n    Layout L;\n    L.n = n;\n    L.nb = (n >= 8192) ? 512 : 256;\n    L.NB = (int)((n + L.nb - 1) / L.nb);\n    L.np = L.NB * L.nb;\n    L.P = P;\n    L.rank = rank;\n    L.nloc = Layout::localColsOf(rank, L.NB, P, L.nb);\n\n    DeviceState d;\n    const size_t locElems = (size_t)L.np * L.nloc;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d.Aloc, std::max<size_t>(locElems, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d.panel,\n                          std::max<size_t>((size_t)std::max(L.np - L.nb, 0) * L.nb, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d.Bg, std::max<size_t>((size_t)L.nloc * L.nb, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d.failFlag, sizeof(int)));\n    {\n        const int minusOne = -1;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d.failFlag, &minusOne, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(L, d);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig.resize(locElems);  // Save original (local part) for validation\n        if (locElems > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(A_orig.data(), d.Aloc, locElems * sizeof(double),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n        fflush(stdout);\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(L, d, comm);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return finish(1);\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", (long)duration.count());\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS Everything else (bulk trailing update)\n// runs concurrently on lower priority CUDA streams.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(const Layout& L, DeviceState& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    if (L.NB == 0) return true;\n\n    const size_t ldl = (size_t)L.nloc;\n    const size_t panelMax = (size_t)std::max(L.np - L.nb, 0) * L.nb + 1;\n    double* hbuf[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hbuf[0], panelMax * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hbuf[1], panelMax * sizeof(double)));\n\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> recvReq[2];\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> sendReq[2];\n    int localStatus[2] = {-1, -1};\n    bool ownedPrev[2] = {false, false};  // rank owned the panel using hbuf[parity] last time\n\n    auto tagOf = [](int k, int chunk) { return (k & 1) * PANEL_CHUNKS + chunk; };\n\n    // Make hbuf[p] reusable: previous sends finished, previous host->device copy finished.\n    auto releaseHostBuffer = [&](int p) {\n        if (!sendReq[p].empty()) {\n            MPI_Waitall((int)sendReq[p].size(), sendReq[p].data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n            sendReq[p].clear();\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(d.evH2D[p]));\n    };\n\n    // Receiver side: post receives for all chunks of panel k.\n    auto postReceive = [&](int k) {\n        const int p = k & 1;\n        releaseHostBuffer(p);\n        const int Mrem = L.np - (k + 1) * L.nb;\n        recvReq[p].assign(PANEL_CHUNKS, MPI_REQUEST_NULL);\n        for (int i = 0; i < PANEL_CHUNKS; ++i) {\n            int b, e;\n            chunkRange(Mrem, i, b, e);\n            const size_t count = (size_t)(e - b) * L.nb + (i == PANEL_CHUNKS - 1 ? 1 : 0);\n            MPI_Irecv(hbuf[p] + (size_t)b * L.nb, (int)count, MPI_DOUBLE, L.ownerOf(k),\n                      tagOf(k, i), comm, &recvReq[p][i]);\n        }\n        ownedPrev[p] = false;\n    };\n\n    // Owner side: panel k has been factored on stream hi. No new files were added.\n\n**Design**\n\n- **MPI:** the zero-padded matrix is distributed 1D block-cyclic over 128-wide block columns, one rank per GPU (ranks on a node pick distinct devices). A right-looking blocked algorithm with look-ahead: the owner of the next panel updates and factors it first and publishes it while every rank runs the bulk trailing update.\n- **Panel exchange:** inside a node, panels are published in row chunks through a page-locked MPI-3 shared-memory window and node-mates copy them straight into their GPUs; node leaders forward chunks to other nodes with non-blocking broadcasts. This replaced MPI copies, which measured at only 5 to 7 GB/s on this node.\n- **CUDA:** all O(n³) work runs in hand-written double-precision kernels (tiled GEMM with diagonal-tile skipping and triangular skipping, row gathers). Three streams of different priority let the look-ahead chain preempt the bulk update. The GEMM reaches the RTX 3090's FP64 peak on one GPU.\n- **OpenMP:** each panel's diagonal block is factored on the host with vectorized reductions, together with the inverse of its factor, overlapping GPU work; the rows below are then one wide GEMM. Host packing, unpacking, and validation reductions are multithreaded, and the thread count defaults to cores divided by ranks per node.\n- **Semantics:** same CLI, output lines, result printing, validation logic, and exit codes.
